gold.name: Gold Pieces
gold.description: The coin of Quadria. Earn it by selling what you gather and make; spend it at shops.

copperOre.name: Copper Ore
copperOre.description: Orange-veined ore. Smelt it into a Copper Ingot at a furnace.

copperIngots.name: Copper Ingot
copperIngots.description: Refined copper. Work it at an anvil with a Crude Hammer.

copperDagger.name: Copper Dagger
copperDagger.description: A copper blade you can smith yourself. One hand · +10 melee Power and Accuracy · stab or slash · trains Dagger proficiency.

copperShield.name: Copper Shield
copperShield.description: One hand · +50 resistance (5% less damage) · trains Shield proficiency when hit or blocking. Cannot be held with a bow.

bows.name: Training Bow
bows.description: Two hands · +10 ranged Power and Accuracy · range 6 tiles. Uses one Training Arrow per shot, including misses.

arrows.name: Training Arrows
arrows.description: Ammunition for the Training Bow. Fletch offers more when you run out.

swords.name: Stone Sword
swords.description: A sturdy stone blade. One hand · +6 melee Power and Accuracy · trains Sword proficiency.

crudeShield.name: Crude Shield
crudeShield.description: Sticks lashed around a rock boss. One hand · +30 resistance (3% less damage) · trains Shield proficiency when hit or blocking.

hammers.name: Crude Hammer
hammers.description: A reusable tool for carpentry and bridge repairs.

rods.name: Crude Fishing Rod
rods.description: Keep this reusable rod in your inventory to fish.

flint.name: Flint
flint.description: A sharp fragment found near water. Useful for starting fires.

firestarters.name: Flint and Stone
firestarters.description: A reusable fire-starting tool. Required to craft a Campfire.

campfires.name: Campfire
campfires.description: Place on clear ground to cook fish. Can be packed up again.

rawFish.name: Raw Pondfish
rawFish.description: A fresh catch. Cook it at a Campfire before eating.

cookedFish.name: Cooked Pondfish
cookedFish.description: A warm meal. Restores 20 health, up to your maximum.

sticks.name: Sticks
sticks.description: A small handful of fallen sticks. Useful for crafting simple tools.

stones.name: Rocks
stones.description: A handful of moderately sized rocks. Useful for crafting simple tools.

pickaxes.name: Crude Pickaxe
pickaxes.description: A simple pickaxe for mining boulders. Keep it in your inventory to use it.

stone.name: Stone
stone.description: A larger piece of mined stone, useful for making stone equipment.

crudeAxe.name: Crude Axe
crudeAxe.description: A simple axe for chopping trees. Keep it in your inventory to use it.

poplarWood.name: Poplar Wood Pieces
poplarWood.description: Light, pale wood from a Poplar Tree. The everyday crafting wood.

aslaWood.name: Asla Wood Pieces
aslaWood.description: Feather-light wood from an Asla Tree. Soft and easy to shape.

pineWood.name: Pine Wood Pieces
pineWood.description: Resinous wood from a Pine Tree. Cheap and plentiful.

oakWood.name: Oak Wood Pieces
oakWood.description: Strong, dependable wood from an Oak Tree.

willowWood.name: Willow Wood Pieces
willowWood.description: Supple wood from a Willow Tree. It bends before it breaks.

mapleWood.name: Maple Wood Pieces
mapleWood.description: Hard, fine-grained wood from a Maple Tree.

walnutWood.name: Walnut Wood Pieces
walnutWood.description: Dark, handsome wood from a Walnut Tree.

ironwood.name: Ironwood Pieces
ironwood.description: Wood from an Ironwood Tree, heavy as stone.

mungilWood.name: Mungil Wood Pieces
mungilWood.description: Oily, very dense wood from a Mungil Tree. It sinks in water.

cherryWood.name: Cherry Wood Pieces
cherryWood.description: Rosy wood from a Cherry Blossom Tree. Prized by fine crafters.

hats.name: Top Hat
hats.description: A rather fancy reward for a hard-working adventurer. Equip it here to wear it.

staffs.name: Simple Staff
staffs.description: A wooden staff topped with a glowing crystal. Spell focus: +6 magic Power and Accuracy to your spells while held. One hand · +5 melee Power and Accuracy · bludgeoning swing · trains Staff proficiency.

ironSkullcap.name: Iron Skullcap
ironSkullcap.description: Sergeant Bristle's brimless iron cap, with a raised ridge and cheek guards. Equip it to wear it.

minersCap.name: Miner's Cap
minersCap.description: Borin's sturdy cap, with a little lamp at the front. Equip it to wear it.

archerCap.name: Archer's Cap
archerCap.description: Fletch's feathered felt cap: peak in front, brim turned up behind. Equip it to wear it.

wizardHat.name: Wizard Hat
wizardHat.description: Wisp's tall hat with a curled tip, gold band and stars. Equip it to wear it.

breathHeadband.name: Breath Headband
breathHeadband.description: Ember's cloth headband, with a ring of calm breath floating above. Equip it to wear it.

fishersHat.name: Fisher's Hat
fishersHat.description: Reed's wide-brimmed straw hat, for long days by the water. Equip it to wear it.

package.name: Package
package.description: A parcel for someone in town. Deliver it by talking to them.

companionHats.name: Companion Top Hat
companionHats.description: A tiny, very dapper top hat with a flower on the band. Put it on your companion here.
